ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (7) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Не противиться злому» (ne protivit'sya zlomu, 'not to resist evil'), «злодей» (zlodey, 'evildoer'), «насилие/насиловать» (nasilie/nasilovat', 'violence/do violence to'), and «подвиг / подвижник» (podvig / podvizhnik, 'feat / ascetic') are kept literal; «сын божий» (syn bozhiy, 'son of God') keeps the source's lowercase. The Gospel saying (Luke 15:7, 10) is translated from the Russian as quoted, and the heading keeps the roman numeral «I» as printed.
Source observation: [1] The heading «## I ПОКАЯНИЕ» carries a roman numeral I, but the reading has no part II; translated as printed (“## I REPENTANCE”).
